summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by NexGen Energy Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, announcing a Q1 2026 earnings conference call scheduled for May 7, 2026. The filing provides an operational update on the 100%-owned Rook I uranium project, including infrastructure, drilling, and market dynamics, but does not involve a special situation transaction. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are present. The filing is an ordinary operational update with no special-situation activity. No comparable US event is triggered.
